calls.title: Maradonna Sihon and Jake Heier
calls.summary: Jake Heier (vendor) discussed GrowthBook's self-hosted deployment with Puspita Simamora and Izam Nurazwar (telecom cell team). Key pain points included centralizing GrowthBook across multiple AWS clusters, ensuring scalability and low latency for millions of customers, and choosing between self-hosted, SaaS, or AWS marketplace tiers.
